output.notes: Base Code Llama (with LCFT) is described; block attributes use the 7B config. The paper restates no layer dimensions, norm, activation, bias or tying choices; these are marked inherited from Llama 2 on the strength of the sentence saying all models are initialized from Llama 2 weights, which requires an identical architecture. The inherited values (7B 4096/32/32/32/11008; 13B 5120/40/40/40/13824; 34B 8192/48/64 heads/8 kv/22016; 70B 8192/80/64 heads/8 kv/28672; RMSNorm eps 1e-5; SwiGLU) come from the Llama 2 ancestor and are not in this paper. Vocab size is left not_stated: the paper uses the Llama 2 tokenizer plus 4 FIM tokens but gives no number. RoPE theta 1e6 and the 16384 sequence length are stated for the LCFT stage, which applies to all released base models. Pairing is read as interleaved from the paper's 2x2 block-diagonal rotation formula.
